products.name: 16-Symbol Quick Chart
products.shortDescription: Multi-symbol dashboard that monitors every trendline on your charts and alerts you when price touches support or resistance.
overview: 16-Symbol Quick Chart is a multi-symbol dashboard that watches the trendlines you have drawn on your charts and tells you the moment price reaches one of them. You do not need to name the lines or give them a special color. Every trendline is monitored automatically.

Each symbol gets its own card showing the symbol name, live price, current status and ATR. When price touches a trendline below the current price (support), the card turns green and a sound alert plays. When price touches a trendline above (resistance), the card turns red with an alert. The chart you are currently on is always highlighted in gold, so you never lose track of where you are.

Click any card and the chart switches to that symbol instantly. The tool comes with a ready list of popular instruments, including Gold, Silver, major Forex pairs, DJ30 and major cryptocurrencies, and the whole list is fully editable. The footer shows your live floating P/L and margin level.
features: 16 symbols on one compact dashboard
Monitors all trendlines automatically, no naming or color needed
Green alert when price touches support (line below price)
Red alert when price touches resistance (line above price)
Current chart card highlighted in gold
Live price, status and ATR on every card
Click any card to switch the chart instantly
Sound alerts with adjustable cooldown
Floating P/L and margin level in the footer
Pre-loaded symbols: XAUUSD, XAGUSD, majors, DJ30, BTC, ETH and more, all editable
requirements: The symbols must be available in your Market Watch

sections.title: How it works
items: Draw trendlines on the charts of the symbols you follow, in any color and with any name
The dashboard keeps watching those lines and compares them with live price
A line below price is treated as support and a line above price as resistance
When price touches a line, the card changes color and the sound alert plays
Click a card to open that symbol on your chart

sections.title: Card colors
items: Green: price touched a support line (trendline below price)
Red: price touched a resistance line (trendline above price)
Gold: this is the symbol of the chart you are currently viewing

sections.title: Good to know
items: The sound alert has an adjustable cooldown, so a line that price keeps touching does not spam you
The symbol list is fully editable, so you can replace the defaults with your own instruments
Every symbol you use must be visible in your Market Watch

products.name: Live Timeframe Candles
products.shortDescription: Multi-timeframe panel with live countdown timers, one-click timeframe switching and real-time mini candle previews.
overview: Live Timeframe Candles is a clean on-chart panel that puts every timeframe in one place. It lists all timeframes from M1 to Monthly and shows a live countdown for each one until its current candle closes, so you always know how long is left before a candle completes.

Click any timeframe button to switch the chart to it immediately. You can also toggle individual timeframes on to see a live mini-candle preview with real-time Open, High, Low and Close values, which gives you multi-timeframe awareness without opening extra charts. Optional chart styling gives the candles a cleaner look.
The panel is fast, lightweight and works on any broker and any symbol.
features: Full list of timeframes from M1 to Monthly
Live countdown timer until each candle closes
One-click switch to any timeframe
Toggleable live mini-candle previews with real-time OHLC
Optional chart candle styling
Clean, lightweight and customizable on-chart panel

sections.title: How to use it
items: Watch the countdown next to each timeframe to time your entries around candle closes
Click a timeframe to switch the chart to it
Toggle a timeframe on to show its live mini-candle with OHLC values
Turn on the optional chart styling if you want cleaner candles

sections.title: Good for
items: Waiting for an H1, H4 or Daily candle to close before deciding
Checking what higher timeframe candles are doing without changing the chart
Traders who work with several timeframes on a single screen

products.name: TradingView Tools for MT5
products.shortDescription: Clean floating toolbar with TradingView-style drawing tools: trend lines, zones, FVG, order blocks, risk/reward, Fibonacci and measure.
overview: TradingView Tools for MT5 brings a clean, professional floating toolbar to MetaTrader 5, inspired by the drawing tools traders know from TradingView. The panel is fully draggable and can be minimized, so it stays out of the way when you do not need it.

Draw Trend Lines, Zones, Fair Value Gaps (FVG) and Order Blocks with one or two clicks. The Risk/Reward tool calculates correctly and its boxes are fully movable and resizable. You also get Fibonacci retracement levels and a Measure tool that shows pips, bars and percentage.
Magnet mode snaps your drawings precisely to candle highs and lows. Select, Delete and Clear All are always one click away, and colors and opacity can be customized for every tool.
features: Fully draggable and minimizable floating panel
Trend Line, Zone, FVG and Order Block tools with one or two clicks
Risk/Reward tool with correct calculation, movable and resizable
Fibonacci retracement levels
Measure tool (pips, bars, percentage)
Magnet mode for precise snapping
Select, Delete and Clear All functions
Customizable colors and opacity for every tool

sections.title: The tools
items: Trend Line: draw with two clicks
Zone: mark supply, demand or any area on the chart
FVG: highlight Fair Value Gaps
Order Block: mark order block areas
Risk/Reward: movable and resizable boxes with correct calculation
Fibonacci retracement levels
Measure: distance in pips, bars and percentage

sections.title: Helpers
items: Magnet mode snaps drawings to candle highs and lows
Select tool to move and edit drawings
Delete removes a drawing, Clear All removes everything you drew
Color and opacity settings for every tool
Minimize the panel when you want a clean chart

products.name: SMC Map
products.shortDescription: Smart Money Concepts visualizer that draws unmitigated FVGs, Order Blocks and swing levels with a live info panel. It never places trades.
overview: SMC Map is a pure visualization tool for traders who use Smart Money Concepts (SMC / ICT-style analysis). It does not place any trades. It only draws and keeps updated the most important institutional zones and levels, so you can read market structure at a glance.

It is made for traders who already understand FVG, Order Blocks and market structure and want a clean, reliable visual layer that stays up to date automatically, without clutter or lag. No trading logic, no signals, no orders.
features: Unmitigated bullish and bearish Fair Value Gaps with ATR size filter
BOS-based bullish and bearish Order Blocks
Latest unbroken Swing Highs and Swing Lows
Mitigation by close or by wick
Separate ON/OFF toggles for FVG, Order Blocks and Swings, saved per chart
Live info panel with bias, zone counts and nearest zones
Fully customizable colors, transparency, fonts, lookback and zone limits
Recalculates only on new bars, so it stays light
Objects are non-selectable and hidden from the Objects list
Analysis only: no trading logic, no signals, no orders

sections.title: Fair Value Gaps (FVG)
sections.text: Detects valid, still unmitigated bullish and bearish Fair Value Gaps.
items: Gaps below a minimum size (based on ATR) are ignored
A zone is removed when price fully mitigates it, by close or by wick, your choice
You can limit how many recent valid FVGs are shown per direction

sections.title: Order Blocks (BOS-based)
sections.text: Identifies bullish and bearish Order Blocks that form after a Break of Structure.
items: Uses the last opposing candle before the break
Only unmitigated Order Blocks are kept
Newest valid blocks are prioritized and older ones are trimmed to your limit

sections.title: Swing High / Swing Low levels
sections.text: Marks the most recent unbroken swing highs and lows, useful for key structure points and potential liquidity pools.
items: Swing strength is fully adjustable
A level disappears once it is broken by a close

sections.title: Information panel
sections.text: A modern panel on the middle-left side of the chart shows:
items: Current symbol and timeframe
Live price
Overall structure bias (Bullish / Bearish BOS)
Number of active bullish and bearish FVGs
Number of active bullish and bearish Order Blocks
Latest valid Swing High and Swing Low prices
Nearest FVG and nearest Order Block to current price

sections.title: Settings you can change
items: Colors, fill transparency and fonts
Extension length of boxes and lines
Lookback period and maximum number of zones
Mitigation method: close or wick

products.name: TF & Session Levels
products.shortDescription: Premium panel that draws the High and Low of M1 to Monthly candles and the Asia, Tokyo, London and New York session ranges. Visual only, no trading.
overview: TF & Session Levels draws the key levels most traders mark by hand: the High and Low of higher-timeframe candles and the High and Low of each trading session. Everything is controlled from a compact premium panel on your chart, where each item has its own ON/OFF toggle.

For 8 timeframes (M1, M5, M15, H1, H4, D1, W1 and MN1) it extends a High line and a Low line to the right of the chart, each timeframe in its own color, with a label showing the price. You can base the levels on the previous candle or on the current candle.

For 4 sessions (Asia, Tokyo, London and New York) it draws a box around each session's range for the last several days and shows the session High and Low. A live status bar in the panel header shows which sessions are open right now.
This tool is analysis only. It never places, modifies or closes any order.

sections.title: Timeframe levels
items: 8 timeframes: M1, M5, M15, H1, H4, D1, W1 and MN1
High and Low lines with price labels, each timeframe in its own color
Previous candle mode (the last closed candle) or Current candle mode
Only the timeframes you switch on are drawn, D1 is on by default

sections.title: Session ranges
items: 4 sessions: Asia, Tokyo, London and New York
A box for each session on the last days (5 by default, adjustable)
Session High and Low are shown on the box and in the panel
Optional box fill
Sessions that cross midnight, such as Asia, are handled correctly
Session hours are set in GMT. The tool detects your broker's GMT offset automatically, or you can enter it manually

sections.title: The panel
items: Header with session status bar: open sessions light up in their own color
Badge showing how many levels are active
Collapse button to shrink the panel to the header
One row per timeframe and per session with an ON/OFF toggle
High values in green and Low values in red, a dash when a level is off or has no data
Your toggles and the collapsed state are remembered per symbol

sections.title: Settings
items: Level mode: previous candle or current candle
Number of session days to draw
Fill session boxes: on or off
Automatic GMT offset, or a manual offset in hours
Start and end hour (GMT) for Asia, Tokyo, London and New York
Panel position X and Y, and font size

sections.title: Installation
items: Copy the file into MQL5/Experts in your MetaTrader 5 data folder
Restart MetaTrader 5 or refresh the Navigator
Drag it onto a chart and turn on the timeframes and sessions you want

features: High and Low levels for M1, M5, M15, H1, H4, D1, W1 and MN1
Previous or current candle mode
Asia, Tokyo, London and New York session boxes with High and Low
Live session status bar in the panel header
Automatic broker GMT offset detection, or manual offset
Fully editable session hours
Individual ON/OFF toggle for every timeframe and session
Settings and toggles remembered per symbol
Collapsible panel with adjustable position and font size
Objects are non-selectable and hidden, and are removed cleanly when the tool is removed
Analysis only: no orders are ever placed
requirements: Enough chart history for the timeframes and sessions you turn on

products.name: Trade Quality Monitor
products.shortDescription: Analytics panel for your own trading: live spread, exposure, slippage, costs, performance stats, session breakdown and CSV export. Analysis only.
overview: Trade Quality Monitor is a scrollable analytics panel that shows how good your trading and your execution really are. It reads your account history and your open positions and turns them into clear numbers, all on the chart.

The panel is split into five sections: live market conditions, current exposure, execution and costs, performance of closed trades, and a breakdown by trading session. You can view Today, This week, This month or All history, and look at only the current symbol or at all symbols.
This tool NEVER places, modifies or closes any order. It is made for traders who want to measure and improve their own results, whether they trade manually or use other tools.

sections.title: Live market
items: Spread now, plus average, minimum and maximum spread
Ticks per minute
Server time
Spread alert: warns you when spread jumps above its average

sections.title: Exposure

Long and short lots
Net lots on the current symbol
Floating P/L with the percentage of your balance
Margin level

sections.title: Execution and costs

Commission and fees
Swap
Costs as a percentage of gross winnings

sections.title: Performance (closed trades)
items: Number of trades, wins and losses
Win rate and net profit/loss
Profit factor
Expectancy per trade
Average win, average loss and payoff ratio
Maximum consecutive losses
Maximum drawdown, with the percentage of your balance
Average holding time

sections.title: Sessions
sections.text: Trades are grouped by the session in which they were opened (server time): Asia, London, New York and Off-hours. For each one you see the number of trades, net result and win rate, so you can find the sessions where you really perform best.

sections.title: Using the panel
items: Period buttons: Today, Week, Month and All
Scope button: this symbol only or all symbols
Scroll with the mouse wheel over the panel, by dragging the scrollbar, or with the arrow buttons
Collapse button to shrink the panel to its title bar
Export CSV button saves your closed trades to the MQL5/Files folder (position ID, symbol, open and close time, holding seconds, net P/L and session)

Magic number filter (-1 for all trades)
History refresh interval
Session hours in server time
Spread alert multiplier (0 turns it off), with popup and push notification options
Panel corner (bottom left, bottom right or top right), start collapsed, visible rows, row spacing, margins, font size and column width
Full color control for background, rows, text, positive and negative values

sections.title: Installation
items: Copy the file into MQL5/Experts in your MetaTrader 5 data folder
Restart MetaTrader 5 or refresh the Navigator
Drag it onto any chart. For push notifications, set up MetaQuotes ID in the terminal options

Ticks per minute and server time
Exposure overview: positions, long/short lots, net lots, floating P/L, margin level
Slippage, commission, swap and cost ratio
Win rate, profit factor, expectancy, payoff ratio and drawdown

Session breakdown: Asia, London, New York and Off-hours
Today, Week, Month and All history periods
Current symbol or all symbols, with optional magic number filter
CSV export of closed trades
Scrollable, collapsible panel with full color customization
